materials.title: CSDIY catalog snapshot for EECS 498-007 / 598-005
materials.allowed_use: Course identity, prerequisites, language, provenance, and resource discovery

blocked.material: Official lecture sequence, unit boundaries, and schedule
blocked.reason: The snapshot supplies links but no verified official course structure or local source bodies.
blocked.impact: Later jobs must not infer a full course graph from link order or normalized record order.

blocked.material: Official lecture notes, slides, recordings, and transcripts
blocked.reason: No such content is present in the job input or workspace; linked pages and videos were not fetched.
blocked.impact: None of these materials is required for the manager-authored kickoff.

blocked.material: Official assignments, starter code, datasets, solutions, tests, and grading specifications
blocked.reason: No verified assignment assets are present, and the catalog links alone do not establish availability or permission.
blocked.impact: The kickoff uses an original task contract and no official assignment content.

blocked.material: Bodies of the textbook, course site, playlist, and linked repository
blocked.reason: External retrieval is outside this preparation job; URL presence is not evidence of content availability.

blocked.material: Any authenticated, paywalled, private, hidden-grader, sealed-reference, or access-controlled content
blocked.reason: No authorization or need was supplied, and access controls must not be bypassed.
blocked.impact: Such content must remain absent from learner views and future retrieval unless policy explicitly permits it.

later_retrieval_requires: A separately authorized, network-capable retrieval job
A public or explicitly authorized source
License and access-condition review before copying content
Captured canonical URL, retrieval provenance, content checksum, and retrieval result
Explicit availability and validation labels on every stored artifact
classification_rules: A URL is LINKED or DISCOVERED, never AVAILABLE, until retrieval and validation succeed.
A normalized resource record is not an official unit without independent official provenance.
A retrieval failure remains a durable blocked record and must not be silently converted into available material.
Later unit expansion may use only verified materials or explicitly manager-authored self-contained content.
prohibited: Credential use not explicitly authorized for the retrieval job
Bypassing authentication, paywalls, robots controls, or technical access restrictions
Copying solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's work into student-safe locations
Claiming that linked or partially retrieved content is locally available
